ranking_points.note: Regional and FIRST Championship thresholds are published through Team Updates; PREMIER Events may set their own thresholds. The app uses standard-event thresholds unless overridden for the event.

review_event_types.label: LEAVE (AUTO)
review_event_types.criteria: Robot no longer contacts the perimeter wall at end of AUTO.

review_event_types.label: HIVE TIP (AUTO)
review_event_types.criteria: HIVE transitions to the other stable state with the upward CELL facing up and the previously free damper contacting the frame. TIPS are assessed through the end of the MATCH.

review_event_types.label: HIVE TIP (TELEOP)
review_event_types.criteria: HIVE transitions to the other stable state with the upward CELL facing up and the previously free damper contacting the frame. TIPS are assessed through the end of the MATCH.

review_event_types.label: POLLEN/NECTAR remaining in upward CELL
review_event_types.criteria: Count elements remaining in the upward-facing CELL after all robots and elements come to rest.

review_event_types.label: Bottom NECTAR bonus
review_event_types.criteria: Alliance whose color NECTAR is lowest while meeting FLOWER scoring criteria.

review_event_types.label: Element in owned FLOWER
review_event_types.criteria: A FLOWER is owned by the alliance with the highest qualifying NECTAR; score each qualifying POLLEN and NECTAR in that FLOWER for its owner, regardless of who placed it.

review_event_types.label: POLLEN/NECTAR in GARDEN
review_event_types.criteria: Score each qualifying element for the color of the GARDEN, regardless of which alliance placed it.

review_event_types.label: MINOR FOUL credit to opponent
review_event_types.criteria: REFEREE-assessed MINOR FOUL awards 5 match points to the opposing alliance.

review_event_types.label: MAJOR FOUL credit to opponent
review_event_types.criteria: REFEREE-assessed MAJOR FOUL awards 20 match points to the opposing alliance.

review_event_types.label: Manual alliance score adjustment
review_event_types.criteria: Use only to record an official score correction supported by the event score; add a note.

review_note: Point values follow Manual Section 10.5, Tables 10-2 and 10-3 (TU09). Official scoring includes end-state checks, alliance-dependent ownership, foul credits, and event-specific Ranking Points. Video alone cannot determine referee rulings, ownership, or event count. A human must verify evidence and may attribute a scoring achievement to the alliance that receives its points, separately from the robot believed to have caused it.
